source_contract_readback.ui: The Studio has separate avatar, full-video, and Instagram-connect actions. It shows completed video previews, full scripts/captions, published post URLs, available metrics, quota, and Stop. Readiness gates keep API/job/quota effects off until each capability is ready.
source_contract_readback.generation: The job path creates a fictional portrait with Gemini, a source-grounded script and caption, a HeyGen Photo Avatar, Starfish speech, then a 9:16 1080p Avatar IV video. The free allowance counts completed artifacts, while failed attempts use a bounded retry allowance.
source_contract_readback.instagram: Connect requires an avatar and at least one completed video. It saves explicit auto-post intent before OAuth. An authenticated status read verifies the Instagram account and publishing access, then turns on daily automation. Existing completed videos post first; daily generation continues only with free allowance or an active subscription.
source_contract_readback.scheduler: Netlify schedules monk-factory-tick every minute; the worker selects due accounts and schedules the next daily post. Stop clears auto_post and auto_post_intent.
source_contract_readback.limitation: Static source and existing test paths are present, but production generation, OAuth, posting, metrics, pause/stop, and checkout were not exercised because Factory runtime prerequisites are absent.
source_contract_readback.lifecycle_controls: Stop is implemented and clears auto_post plus auto_post_intent. A separate temporary Pause/Resume control is not present in the current UI/API; tracked as FACTORY-PAUSE-1.
